items.title: SK Telecom's AI model push offers a blueprint for telcos seeking sovereignty

items.title: Studies say: Mobile carriers can chill – satellites can’t go it alone
items.summary: Based on recent studies and a WIA panel discussion, one could reasonably conclude that terrestrial mobile networks will survive – even though popular perception says Elon Musk’s SpaceX will obliterate them.

items.title: Charter’s CFO departs; AT&T sues Charter for false advertising
items.summary: AT&T's lawsuit claims that Charter’s advertising for its broadband service uses words such as “fiber powered” to deceptively suggest a fiber-to-the-home service.

items.title: Here's one fiber network builder who doesn't leave communities behind
